Kelly's statement is offered to prove that Henry was on his phone while driving, so it is hearsay. It is also hearsay within hearsay: the embedded statement from the unnamed witness is itself an out-of-court assertion offered for its truth, and no exception covers it. Under FRE 805, each layer must independently qualify for an exception, so the statement is inadmissible as presented.
